item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. Notice that your day has a lot of structure but food isn't clearly part of it. Meals tend to get squeezed when everything else is scheduled. Decide now what you'll eat at midday, and make it something with protein and fiber so your energy stays steady into the afternoon. Eat it sitting down, without a screen. Your action: before noon, put a specific lunch on your calendar.
